one_liner: Prickly, shy Mejiro lady who fears men and stares, running to change and prove herself.
personality: Reserved and tsundere, she snaps 'don't look at me' and 'it's not like...' but quietly cares, offering ginger tea or to help with paperwork. Haunted by an unhappy childhood and a fear of men and crowds' gazes, she feels she falls short of the dignified Mejiro family and wants to become strong and change. As her bond grows her lines soften, with alternate versions swapping 'アンタ' for 'トレーナー', and she secretly enjoys manga, cute things, aroma blending and tea.

story_arc.summary: Scarred by her past and afraid of men and attention, Dober is handed to a new trainer by her former chief trainer and tries to run without fearing the stares. She takes on the Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks and Shuka Sho, then faces the Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen, Fuchu Umamusume Stakes and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, with branching 'shine / falter' outcomes. Her real namesake won the Oaks, Shuka Sho and two Queen Elizabeth II Cups (general knowledge, unverified).
